slides.title: China's Horn envoy went to Asmara. What was said?
Eritrea's president met China's envoy
slides.body: Eritrean state media says they met in Asmara on Nov 5.

slides.title: Beijing's stated position
slides.body: The envoy stressed respect for Eritrea's sovereignty and territorial integrity, per Eritrean state media.

slides.title: Visit follows Addis Ababa talks
slides.body: Ethiopia's foreign ministry said a Chinese envoy met its foreign minister on regional peace (via Borkena). Single sources.
